datasets.name: Pathak 40 aircraft passages
datasets.notes: WAV, extracted frequency CSV and aircraft KML supplied. Example WAV has no embedded recording time. UTC on author-extracted ridge points is not evidence of WAV sample-zero UTC. No independent receiver-position reference established in reviewed release materials.

datasets.name: AeroSonicDB YPAD-0523 v1.1.2
datasets.notes: Publisher substitutes nearby roads/public spaces for exact recorder coordinates. Existing six environmental background excerpts remain useful component controls.

datasets.name: AeroSonicDB 3K
datasets.notes: Release files restricted; no access request or email sent.

datasets.name: SONYC-UST-V2
datasets.notes: Paper specifies ten-second snippets, block-level location and hour-level time. Insufficient for the unchanged minimum-20-second Doppler event screen and precise flight alignment.

datasets.name: TartanAviation
datasets.notes: Audio modality is radio communications; alignment to ADS-B does not make it an acoustic engine-overflight recording.

datasets.name: TU Delft Cessna Skymaster measurements
datasets.notes: Publisher describes processed overhead spectra for flyovers and time-pressure data for engine runups. Full moving flyover waveforms and independent alignment were not verified. Do not equate stationary runups with Doppler passages.

datasets.name: WSU synchronized UAV acoustics
datasets.notes: Public catalog describes WAV, telemetry and per-session alignment files. Direct README requests returned HTTP 403 in this environment. Documentation/files not inspected; controlled drone experiments are separate from the ADS-B aircraft pilot.

datasets.name: TrueNoise observations
datasets.notes: Reviewed download exports observation/psychoacoustic metrics as CSV. No raw pressure waveform was established for spectral Doppler reconstruction.

requirements: Raw moving-aircraft waveform, long enough for unchanged discovery defaults.
Independent evidence of the microphone position and its uncertainty.
Documented mapping from waveform sample zero to trajectory time, with uncertainty.
Compatible timestamped trajectory geometry and vertical datum.
interpretation: A finite evidence audit, not proof that no suitable public dataset exists. Unknown items remain unknown; extracted ridges, nearby coordinates and fitted clocks are not promoted to independent references.
